title: Application for Federal Domestic Assistance-Short Organizational
description: SF-424 Short Organizational definition and source plan (FID711 v3.0), preserving existing SGG answer paths and reusing current question-bank parts. The native preview is a library-side capture proof; service population, signing and XML/submission integration remain separate.
notes: This definition and its source plan retain all 74 source answer coordinates as 72 logical fields: three applicant-type slots are represented by one min1/max3 ordered array with explicit DAT and XML source_bindings. No source slot is omitted and no generated mapping is asserted.

Six DAT pre-populated context fields (agency name, assistance listing number/title, opportunity number/title, UEI) and three post-populated submission outputs (received date, signature, signed date) retain their source ownership. Proposed samples use fictional opportunity/organization context; they do not implement service population or signing.

Existing SGG always requires contact_person even when same_as_project_director is true, while DAT8-02 says skip to item9. The plan preserves the source instruction and the current separate role paths; no copy, omission, clearing or disabled-field policy is approved here.

Country-dependent State/ZIP requiredness is stated separately from Province activity. US examples use nine-digit ZIP+4; that avoids but does not settle DAT guidance versus existing API/general-XSD admission of shorter values.

Applicant address and the two contact addresses reuse the same semantic address parts at their existing SGG paths. The authorized representative is a separate signing role. Display sections are not new data containers.

DAT9-01 and9-03 certification text is retained verbatim on the certification section, including the source spelling. Current SGG presents a lightly edited version; preserve the distinction during source-policy review rather than silently rewriting legal copy.

Existing SGG represents applicant-type H with lower-case state; its maintained XML normalization maps it to the XSD Public/State label. Proposed answers retain the current API spelling. PR12948 now targets main and is not a dependency for this plan; no date-order rule is borrowed from it.

The Other Applicant Type detail is conditionally required when applicant_type_code contains X. Existing SGG leaves the detail enabled otherwise. The plan does not add a scalar-equality UI predicate to an array or extend the compiler.

Plan-review examples are fictional and have independent director/contact/authorized-representative identities. They omit received date, signature and signed date because they depict drafts. Pinned existing-SGG test fixtures are shown separately and are unchanged, including their known five-digit US ZIP and placeholder values.

Actual population, authenticated ownership, saving/reloading, signing, attachment services, generated XML and submission remain later integration work owned with Billy. The prior compiled candidate is reused and qualified on the current P1 foundation; this does not establish production acceptance.

DAT0-0 burden statement: Clicking displays burden statement:
SF-424 SHORT ORGANIZATIONAL FORM (4040-0003)

According to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, an agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to a collection of information unless it displays a valid OMB control number. The valid OMB control number for this information collection is 4040-0003. The time required to complete this information collection is estimated to average 24 minutes per response, including the time to review instructions, search existing data resources, gather the data needed and complete and review the information collection. If you have comments concerning the accuracy of the time estimate(s) or suggestions for improving this form, please write to: U.S. Department of Health & Human Services, OS/OCIO/PRA, 200 Independence Ave., S.W., Suite 537-H, Washington D.C. 20201, Attention: PRA Reports Clearance Officer.

Agency           Total                          Average Burden             Total Burden
                          Responses              per response in               Hours
                                                              Hours

NEA                  7130                          20/60                                      2377
NEH                  2328                          30/60                                      1164
DOI                   416                             18/60                                      125
HHS                  3903                           30/60                                      1952
DOS                  800                             20/60                                      267
DHS                   23                               21/60                                      8
Total                 14600                                                                         5893

5893 total hrs. x 60 minutes = 353,580 total minutes.
353,580 / 14600 total responses = 24 minutes per response.

Native certification copy preserves the exact DAT9-01/9-03 text retained in the reviewed source plan, including its spelling and footnote markers. Existing SGG uses lightly edited wording; this difference is explicit and source-policy acceptance remains pending.
risks: Source-required contact/copy behavior,empty Other description,certification false,date ordering and draft-versus-submission fields need explicit source/consumer decisions where the existing implementation differs. A matched schema does not approve these policies.
Application context,authenticated population,signature,save/reload,upload and submission are unexecuted integration boundaries;synthetic fixtures are not accepted applicant data.

DAT nine-digit US ZIP guidance and web-address maximum50 differ from existing API/general-XSD behavior. Matching current API admission does not settle these source policies. Original XSD requires submission-populated dates/signature before wire validity.

The certification section's DAT wording and the existing SGG copy differ slightly; choose the accepted source policy before shipping a rendered definition. Source statements are retained, not approved by this plan.
